You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def shapes(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r))  # background-ish? use most common
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    frame=[x for x in cnt if x!=bg]
    fcol=max(frame,key=lambda c:sum(1 for r in g for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if r[cc]==c)) if frame else None
    # find frame: largest connected mono component != bg
    import collections
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; best=None
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                seen[i][j]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            na,nb=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==col:
                                seen[na][nb]=True; st.append((na,nb))
                if best is None or len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    cells=set(best)
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    objs=[]
    for col in cnt:
        if col==bg or col==fcol: continue
        cells_c={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col}
        objs.append((col,cells_c,r0,c0,len(cells_c)))
    return g,bg,fcol,cells,objs
def solve(g,demo=True):
    g,bg,fcol,framecells,objs=shapes(g)
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # holes: 0-cells inside frame bbox
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(r for r,c in framecells),max(r for r,c in framecells),min(c for r,c in framecells),max(c for r,c in framecells)
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    free=lambda r,c: out[r][c]==0
    occ=set()
    res=objs[:]  # list of (col,cells,box)
    # order: area desc, tie input row
    res.sort(key=lambda o:(-len(o[3]),min(r for r,c in o[2])) )
    placed=[]
    for col,cells,_,_ in res:
        cur=[sorted(cells)]
        # slide up-left while possible
        def can(dr,dc,s):
            n=[[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in s] for s in cur]
            for s in n:
                for r,c in s:
                    if not(0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and g[r][c]==0): return False
                    if any((r,c) in oc for oc in placed): return False
            return True
        while True:
            ok=can(-1,-1,[cur[0]])
            if ok: cur=[[ (r-1,c-1) for r,c in cur[0]]]
            else: break
        # now slide along each axis? try combined then individual
        placed.append((col,set(cur[0])))
        # ensure maximal: try more aggressive combos
        changes=True
        while changes:
            changes=False
            for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(0,-1),(-1,-1)):
                if can(dr,dc,[placed[-1][1]]):
                    cur=[[ (r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in placed[-1][1]]]
                    placed[-1]=(placed[-1][0],set(cur[0])); changes=True; break
    for col,s in placed:
        for r,c in s: out[r][c]=col
    return out, objs
# verify demo
d=solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(json.dumps(d[0]))
print('objs:', [(o[0],len(o[3]),min(r for r,c in o[2])) for o in d[1]])

def solve(g):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]; best=None
    for i in range(Hh):
        for j in range(Ww):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]; seen[i][j]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            na,nb=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=na<Hh and 0<=nb<Ww and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==g[i][j]:
                                seen[na][nb]=True; st.append((na,nb))
                if best is None or len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    fcol=g[best[0][0]][best[0][1]]
    fr=set(best); c0=min(c for r,c in fr); c1=max(c for r,c in fr)
    oc=c1-c0+1
    objs=[]
    for col in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg,fcol}:
        cc=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if g[r][c]==col and c>c1]
        if not cc: continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cc]; cs=[c for r,c in cc]
        objs.append({'col':col,'top':min(rs),'bot':max(rs),'l':min(cs),'r':max(cs),'h':max(rs)-min(rs)+1})
    out=[[0]*oc for _ in range(Hh)]
    order=sorted(objs,key=lambda o:o['top'],reverse=True)
    cb=Hh-1
    for o in order:
        tp=cb-o['h']+1
        for r in range(tp,cb+1):
            for c in range(o['l'],o['r']+1):
                out[r][c]=o['col']
        cb=tp-1
    return out

        prev=s
    bnd_h=max(b[1]-b[0]+1 for b in bnds)
    def band_idx(r): return next(i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(bnds) if a<=r<=b)
    # assign: pack top-down into bands ordered top to bottom
    canvas=[[bg]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    for r in range(Hh):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): canvas[r][c]=fcol
    pos=0
    cur=0
    assigned=False
    # objects placed sequentially into bands starting from top
    remaining=objs[:]
    bands_sorted=sorted(bnds)
    cur_row=None
    for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(bands_sorted):
        if remaining:
            o=remaining[0]
            o_cand=True
            for rr in range(a,min(b,o['top']+shiftv)):

G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    print(k)
    Hh,Ww=len(gi),len(gi[0]); print(Hh,Ww,'out',len(go),len(go[0]))
    # frame color & bbox
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for col in set(x for r in gi for x in r):
        for comp in comps_of(gi,col):
            if best is None or len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    fcol=g[best[0][0]][best[0][1]]; fr=set(best)
    c0=min(c for _,c in fr); c1=max(c for _,c in fr)
    print('bg',bg,'fcol',fcol,'bbox rows',min(r for r,_ in fr),max(r for r,_ in fr),'cols',c0,c1)
    solids=[r for r in range(Hh) if all(gi[r][c]==fcol for c in range(c0,c1+1))]
    print('solid rows',solids)
    objs=[]
    for col in set(x for r in gi for x in r)-{bg,fcol}:
        for comp in comps_of(gi,col):
            rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cs=[c for _,c in comp]
            if min(cs)>c1:
                objs.append((col,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    print('objs',objs)
    print('out:')
    for r in go: print(''.join(map(str,r)))

G=load()
def objs_of(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for col in set(x for r in gi for x in r):
        for comp in comps_of(gi,col):
            if best is None or len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    fcol=gi[best[0][0]][best[0][1]]; c0=min(c for _,c in best); c1=max(c for _,c in best)
    return bg,fcol,c0,c1
def transform(cells,mode):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    M=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    g=[[M[r][w-1-j] for j in range(w)] for r in range(h)]   # horiz flip
    if mode=='rot180': g=[row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]
    return [tuple(map(tuple,g))],g
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    bg,fcol,c0,c1=objs_of(gi)
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); Oh,OW=len(go),len(go[0])
    print('==',k,'bg',bg,'fcol',fcol,'bbox cols',c0,c1,'out dims',Oh,OW)
    bands=[(a,b) for a,b in [] ] 
    # band boundaries: rows where solid frame exists
    solids=[r for r in range(H) if all(gi[r][c]==fcol for c in range(c0,c1+1))]
    bands=[]
    prev=-2
    for s in sorted(solids)+[H]:
        if s>prev+1: bands.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s
    print('bands',[b for b in bands],'solid rows',solids)
    for col in set(x for r in gi for x in r)-{bg,fcol}:
        for comp in comps_of(gi,col):
            rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cs=[c for _,c in comp]
            if min(cs)<c0 or max(cs)>c1: continue
            rel=[(r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in comp]
            h=max(r for r,_ in rel)+1; w=max(c for _,c in rel)+1
            full=[[1 if (i,j) in {(i,j) for r,c in comp} else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
            mir=[[full[h-1-i][w-1-j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
            vflip=[[full[h-1-i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
            print('obj col',col,'cells',(min(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs)),'shape')
            print(' orig',full); print(' hv',mir); print(' vflip',vflip)
    # what shapes exist in output (non-bg non-fcol?) - out uses bg color too
    ocnt=collections.Counter(x for r in go for x in r)

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=None
    for col in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        for comp in comps_of(g,col):
            if best is None or len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    fcol=g[best[0][0]][best[0][1]]
    c0=min(c for _,c in best); c1=max(c for _,c in best)
    fr=set(best)
    # solid rows: rows where ALL frame-bbox cells are fcol
    solids=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==fcol for c in range(c0,c1+1))]
    bands=[]
    prev=-2
    for s in sorted(solids)+[H]:
        if s>prev+1: bands.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s
    # objects: non-bg, non-fcol components
    objs=[]
    for col in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg,fcol}:
        for comp in comps_of(g,col):
            rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cs=[c for _,c in comp]
            objs.append({'col':col,'cells':comp,'h':max(rs)-min(rs)+1,'w':max(cs)-min(cs)+1})
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(-o['h'],o['top']))
    canvas=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # paint frame: copy original frame cells
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[r][c]==fcol: canvas[r][c]=fcol
    for bi,o in enumerate(reversed(objs)):
        b=bands[len(bands)-1-bi]
        top=b[0]
        for rr,cc in o['cells']:
            nr=top+(rr-min(r for r,_ in o['cells']))
            nc=(cc-min(c for _,c in o['cells']))-(c1-c0)   # slide left by frame width
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=fcol: canvas[nr][nc]=o['col']
    return canvas

    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    ci=collections.Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); co=collections.Counter(x for r in go for x in r)
    bg=ci.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(k,'in size',len(gi),'x',len(gi[0]),'bg',bg, {c:v for c,v in ci.items()})
    print(' out size',len(go),'x',len(go[0]),{c:v for c,v in co.items()})

import collections
def solve(g):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    allc=[]
    for col_ in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}:
        for comp in comps(g,col_): allc.append((col_,comp))
    _,fr=max(allc,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    fcol=g[fr[0][0]][fr[0][1]]
    c0=min(c for _,c in fr); c1=max(c for _,c in fr)
    solids=[r for r in range(Hh) if all(g[r][c]==fcol for c in range(c0,c1+1))]
    bands=[]; prev=-2
    for s in sorted(set(solids)|{Hh}):
        if s>prev+1: bands.append((prev+1,s-1)); prev=s
    objs=[]
    for col_ in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg,fcol}:
        for comp in comps(g,col_):
            rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cs=[c for _,c in comp]
            objs.append({'top':min(rs),'left':min(cs),'w':max(cs)-min(cs)+1,'h':max(rs)-min(rs)+1,'cells':sorted(comp),'col':col_})
    canvas=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c1+1)] for r in range(Hh)]
    order=['1','2','3']  # from demo-2 output row1..11? infer band colors by object sizes
    for i,o in enumerate(sorted(objs,key=lambda o:o['top'])):
        b=bands[i]
        topb=b[0]
        mc=o['left']; mr=o['top']
        for rr,cc in o['cells']:
            nr=topb+(rr-mr); nc=(c1-1)-(o['w']-1)+(cc-mc)
            if 0<=nr<Hh and 0<=nc<c1+1 and canvas[nr][nc]!=fcol: canvas[nr][nc]=o['col']
    return canvas
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

import collections
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    al=[(col_,comp) for col_ in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg} for comp in comps(g,col_)]
    big=max(al,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    fcol=big[0]; fr=big[1]
    c1=max(c for _,c in fr)
    return [[g[r][c] for c in range(c1+1)] for r in range(H)]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
